active_command: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml run --rm api python manage.py run_evaluation --corpus-version 2026.09.1 --split test --evidence-json /workspace/apps/api/evaluation-run-first.artifact.json
monitor: check whether apps/api/evaluation-run-first.artifact.json exists and has non-zero length
resume: If the run container is active, wait for it without starting a second run.
If the temporary artifact exists, validate its JSON and frozen fields, then move it from the host to docs/verification/evaluation-run-first.artifact.json.
If no run is active and neither artifact nor marker exists, re-run active_command exactly as recorded.
If the marker exists but the artifact is absent or invalid, stop and investigate; do not use --force-new-protocol.
constraints: Do not make any new RAWG request; the former RAWG pass 2 is cancelled and does not block plan 02-13.
Do not stage or commit plan 02-06, plan 02-12, data/localization/**, or phase 03 context changes.
